_note: The consult checklists: what the reception collects for each purpose of a chat. The navigator (workers/reception/navigator.py) compares the recorded consult rows with this file and names the step and the notice; nothing here is in code. A purpose is recorded as a row with item purpose_<id> (words: what the customer asked, state: open or done). Each item has an id (the consult row's item), a label (the words of the notice), required, and optionally choices (the words must be one of them; many: several, comma separated) or menu (the style: menu names of salon.json for the services recorded in the item named there, one per service, comma separated, recorded in the consult field named by field; recommend of salon.json when the customer wants a suggestion) or format (phone: a Japanese phone number, read by nextop's phone field type; datetime: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM; name: the name only, without a sentence ending such as です). An item with when applies only when another item has that value. service_items: the per-service questions of salon.json (services.<id>.checklist) join the booking checklist for the services recorded in the item named there. need: why a required item is needed and what cannot go on without it; the step notice names it for the items still missing, so the reception can tell a customer who declines or postpones one.
